data.narrative:
Agile Robots, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company, has raised approximately $384M and carries a current post-money valuation exceeding $1.0B. The valuation assessment triangulates against a peer set of 8 private companies and 1 public comparable, including stage-adjacent players such as Exotec (Series D, $2.0B), Hadrian (Series C, $1.6B), Bedrock Robotics (Series B, $1.8B), and Dexterity (Series B, $1.6B).

Two methods support the valuation range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to next-stage transitions, yielding $1.7B from the $1.0B last post-money base. Peer-median triangulation across 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces an identical $1.7B median, with the peer universe ranging from $1.0B floor to $2.0B ceiling.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median point estimate of $1.7B. Both independent methods converge on this midpoint, suggesting reasonable reliability. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peers, pathway to Series D funding, and the granularity of stage and revenue metrics within the private peer set, where visibility is limited.
